title: reduce runtime gameplay stutters without gameplay changes
problem_statement: Gameplay stutters occur during movement, shooting, collisions, explosions, wave progress, and transitions; initial loading is not the issue.
game_flow_context: movement / shooting / collision feedback / explosions / wave progress / level transitions / HUD / Canvas 2D rendering
scope_inputs: user task: runtime stutter performance fix
validated_decisions: Treat as performance implementation without gameplay design changes.
Skip separate design/programming/impact passes because user supplied explicit non-goals, implementation priorities, validation requirements, and impact files.
Diagnostics must be opt-in through ?perf=1 and inactive in normal mode.
draft_assumptions_in_play: Runtime stutter is likely caused by per-frame DOM writes, repeated static canvas render work, optional visual effects, or audio reset behavior.
Static render caching is acceptable only for non-animated visuals.
current_direction: Add opt-in profiler and perf diagnostic visual downgrades.
Keep audio changes localized if needed.
explicit_non_goals: No visual identity removal in normal mode.
backward_compatibility_concerns: perf overlay must not run unless ?perf=1
static cache invalidation must handle resize and asset readiness
required_validations: node --input-type=module --check < changed-js-file> for every changed JS file
PHPMD if PHP/PHPMD context exists; otherwise mark not applicable
human_test_checklist: ?perf=1 profiler visible and normal mode profiler absent
